name: Aradhika
reason: Feminine of ārādhaka, worshipper; devotional and correct.

name: Ashalata
reason: Āśā plus latā, creeper of hope; well-formed, auspicious.

name: Bhanuja
reason: Bhānujā, daughter of the sun, epithet of Yamuna; IAST and Devanagari agree.

name: Chitralekha
reason: Citralekhā, Usha's friend in the Bhagavata Purana; established name.

name: Gandhali
reason: Devanagari uses anusvara where IAST has ndh; normalise to conjunct. Gloss 'fragrant row' is awkward and etymology of the Marathi name only partly certain.

fix.meaning_en: Row of fragrance (gandha + ālī); etymology partly uncertain

name: Induja
reason: Indujā, born of the moon; traditional epithet of the Narmada, fine as a girl's name.

name: Kanakalata
reason: Kanaka plus latā, golden creeper; well-formed.

name: Madhushree
reason: Gloss 'sweet prosperity' disagrees with the parts line (śrī: beauty); make meaning consistent.

name: Mihika
reason: Mihikā, mist or dew; gentle, in modern use, no negative sense.
